wearing realistic suits
standing, observing, or interacting (e.g. touching glass, wiring panel, reacting)
natural posture and weight distribution
no stiff posing

metallic walls with soft reflections

large viewing window showing space
clean but detailed sci-fi production design

floating in space outside the window
glowing gradient colors (cyan, blue, magenta, purple)
semi-transparent body
soft organic motion feel

cinematic lighting (NOT flat)
soft global illumination
strong contrast between dark interior and glowing exterior

realistic rendering (Unreal Engine / film production level)
NOT illustration
